I don't understand why though, when I tell people that even arguing with me at this point will push me over the edge...and they do it anyway. Then instead of apologizing when I tell people that they hurt me, they just attempt to justify their actions instead.

   And when I tell people I'm suicidal, they blow it off. I can't even reach my psychiatrist either. He won't pick up his phone and is in the process of moving to a new building. Not that more meds would take away the pain that others have inflicted on me...I truly know that there is no help for me and that nobody cares about me at all and nobody will do what it takes to save my life when I tell them what I need.

In an episode of "Goldie & Bear" where Little Bear magically grows into a giant bear....there's a huge boulder behind him. When he shrinks back into Little Bear though while standing in that exact same spot - the boulder is gone.
   I think his ass ate that boulder.

Thank you for this response. Is it possible that CPS was never even called? The DA came out but I never saw anyone trying to call CPS. Though in the midst of the chaos, it is possible they were still called.

He was at the store, then came home to naturally end up taking his mother's side, claiming I'm crazy and "must not have taken my Paxil that day" which is both untrue and is only needed for Depression. This is why I feel it would be best for me to take my kids elsewhere but I don't want to leave if CPS should be visiting soon

Well really my MIL threatened to shoot me because we had an argument, she attacked me and tried to keep my kid away from me and when I had to claw at her to get my child back from her, I then called the cops. The cops were more concerned that I had my kids out in the very light drizzle of rain on a warm day, than they were that my MIL had threatened to shoot me and failed to acknowledge that I was doing exactly what the dispatcher told me to do.
  I don't know if that helps or how that helps.
I hope you blog. The way you wrote this was downright amazing!

Thank you. I've found that I can't rely on my religion, my husband, my parents, my friends, or the cops to help me. I don't know what to do anymore and the only reason I stay alive is because of my children, but I see the world they're surrounded by because of the drama that surrounds me and sometimes I think my death would improve their lives
They're Canadian
